title: slashkit flow runbook (single-PR and multi-PR initiative)

slug.description: Flow slug; the flow directory is sk-<slug>. For PR runbooks, the PR slug.

size.description: light = reduced path (single-PR runbooks only); absent = full.

goal.description: One-line user goal for the flow.

active-pr.description: Initiative root only: slug of the in-progress PR, or 'none'.

phases.description: Row state keyed by phase id. Single-PR and PR runbooks: 0,1,1r,2,2r,3,4,5,6. Initiative root: 0,1,1r,2,2r.

input.description: Parent dispatch id or input artifact.

head.description: Resulting git HEAD when the phase changed the repo.

reopened.description: Set when a finished/skipped row is set back to pending (rollback) or unskipped by set --size=full; exempt from ordering checks but still blocks completed.

prs.description: Initiative root only: PR rows keyed by stable slug. Presence selects multi mode.

deps.description: Slugs this PR depends on; [] = none.

divergences.description: Log of departures from the skills; one line each.
